criterion: v4, declared before the single fresh-seed audit: features computed from the rendered prompt strings (raw-arm set: global statistics + claimed account and resource graph profiles; VE-arm set: global statistics + certified subject and resource graph profiles + masked display); per kind and pooled groups vs honest; foldwise AUC over 2 x 5-fold CV; null from 2,000 full-procedure label permutations; two-sided unrounded p. PASS iff (a) every Holm-adjusted multivariate p (2 feature sets x 10 groups x 2 classifiers = 40 tests; smallest attainable 40/2001 = .020) >= .05, (b) every pooled group has unadjusted multivariate p >= .05, and (c) every univariate Mann-Whitney p, Holm-adjusted over all univariate tests, >= .05.
